scope: Decode rates from the single-pass strict quality runs of Qwen3.8-27B: P7 is the DFlash depth 7 control, P4 is the depth 4 candidate. One repetition per case on a fresh server after four warmup requests, 64-112 generated tokens. An unreplicated observation, not a gated measurement.
source: predicted_per_second, predicted_n, draft_n and draft_n_accepted from each row's response timings in the per-arm quality reports named by 27b-release-gates.json. The raw reports are private and not published. Output text hashes match between the two arms in every case.
